evidence: Purdue GIS feature FID 266 identifies BLDG_ABBR AHF and BUILDING_N Animal Holding Facility at 410 S University Street.
The official Purdue polygon and 2016-2020 Indiana footprint comparison reports 0.50 m centroid offset and 1.739 m maximum symmetric vertex-to-boundary distance.
criteria.findings: The building identity is unambiguous and the Purdue survey-style footprint is corroborated by an independent state footprint. The saved model follows the 16-vertex Purdue outline.

evidence: Reopened mesh evaluated XY bounds: X -65.645 to -23.697 m; Y -1030.837 to -955.232 m.
Model bounds differ from the converted Purdue GIS footprint bounds by at most 0.180 m; measured model envelope is 41.948 by 75.605 m.
Each GIS footprint corner is represented within 0.000 m of a model vertex in XY.
Top-down comparison against 2023 Indiana orthophoto visually confirms the building's orientation and campus placement.
criteria.findings: XY position, orientation, and plan scale are strongly supported. The small envelope expansion is consistent with the perimeter wall/roof edge around the GIS polygon.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue GIS attributes report NUM_LEVELS=1 and CountOfFLO=1.
The 2018 Indiana 5-ft NDHM has 614 north/main and 359 south/addition samples; median roof-surface heights are 4.036 m and 5.166 m above ground.
Current model vertical extent is 5.999 m; the southern roof profile trend is supported by multi-bin fits in 4 resolutions.
criteria.findings: The one-floor and two-zone roof massing have source support. Deduct 0.25 because the 5-ft normalized-height raster is not an eave survey and the roof-zone seam/slope remain approximations.

evidence: Purdue AHF-01 emergency-exits plan dated 2023-12-20 explicitly marks 9 red-arrow emergency exits; the asset contains corresponding schematic door panels.
Plan-to-GIS registration is approximate and has a maximum recorded shell residual of 1.923 m.
criteria.findings: This plan supports the existence and approximate plan locations of emergency egress doors only. It does not identify the public/main entrance, facade materials, window rhythm, signage, or distinctive exterior features. Door dimensions, appearance, and placement precision remain estimates; no architectural facade credit is awarded.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Expected collection Asset_massing_animal_holding_facility_4733f46 contains exactly one mesh object named Animal Holding Facility.
Fresh Blender evaluation reports 584 vertices and 466 faces, no modifiers, 0 non-manifold edges, and 0 boundary edges.

criteria.findings: The library asset is portable and structurally valid; its structured evidence covers GIS, orthophoto, lidar, and egress-plan inputs with limitations recorded.

findings: The egress plan justifies a limited schematic emergency-door treatment. It does not resolve the facade/entrance evidence gap.
The building passes the 8/10 threshold from footprint, position, roof/floor, export, and limited exit-location evidence; facade appearance and the primary entrance remain unverified.
